invariants: Original six-second automatic defeat return, deadlines, heart counts, inventory, authoritative grading, rewards, readiness and no-repeat hunting remain owned by their existing systems.

New review context augments existing ArchiveMistake receipts: version, subphase, reset serial and bounded feedback. It retains at most three distinct problems per actor and twelve context strings overall, maximum700 characters each; no mistake record or total is deleted.
Terminal owner Changed event captures the local detached view before a delayed scene-return frame. A destroyed source owner is unbound so no whole live match state is retained.
Legacy metadata without versioned context contributes to totals only; details are not fabricated. Shared clock timeouts are not attributed to an individual.
Full native and Photon QA used explicit excluded Admin/practice fixtures.
limits: No physical Android device was connected. Android touch, audio and performance remain unverified.
Live transport used a rendered Windows Editor client and independent Realtime peers, not multiple rendered mobile clients.
Connection recovery used100percent Photon SDK packet loss, not real mobile-carrier loss.
Only the last local match is cached in memory; it clears on the next match, account change or app restart.
